description: Closed form for the weak-vertex form factor W(q) = tr_M((σ₀σ₁)⁵) in H₃(q), convention D: q²(q¹²+q⁸−1)/(q²+1)². Two exact routes agree (the canonical tr_M_word, and Wedderburn with solved weights y3=(q⁴+1)/(q²+1)², y21=q²/(q²+1)², y111=0), and the numerator is q²²·V_{T(3,5)}(q⁻²) with V = t⁴+t⁶−t¹⁰ (10_124). Closes the one-level-down GAP of qou-jk6k. The published W(q0) ≈ 0.7036 is reproduced by neither convention and is flagged, not edited.

convention.anchor: proton pin (qou_substrate.constants.Q_50_DIGIT_STR) for the numerical values; the closed form itself is exact in q

braid_word: (σ₀σ₁)^5 in B_3 -> H_3(q); torus knot T(3,5) = 10_124

comparison_convention_C_EXCISED.note: deliberate labelled comparison against the excised convention; not a live value

published_value_finding.status: reproduced by neither convention's Ocneanu trace; content corrected in PR #6689 (bean qou-4x7c)
